title: ChatGPT-generated Java objects-first exercise sheets
summary: Nine fifth-semester students solve 12 instructor-reviewed Java exercise sheets during a two-week objects-first programming course. Lecturers generated and revised the sheets with ChatGPT; students received the curated exercises rather than interacting with the model as part of the tasks.

sources.title: Investigating the Use of AI-Generated Exercises for Beginner and Intermediate Programming Courses: A ChatGPT Case Study
